svg.aria-label: The whole distribution marches with the seasons, not just the mean
svg.title: The whole distribution marches with the seasons, not just the mean
svg.desc: Ridgeline plot: one Gaussian kernel-density curve per month, each in its own fully separated lane and its own house-palette hue (blue through teal, green, yellow, orange, red to purple). Each curve's peak shifts right through summer and left in winter, so the whole distribution — not just the mean — moves with the season.
svg.text: The whole distribution marches with the seasons, not just the mean
Daily-high temperature by month, one colour-coded lane each — Illustrative data
